chapter_title: Multimedia Storyboarding and AI Asset Generation
title: Peer Review of Storyboards
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting peer review of storyboards to storyboard frame sequence with narration, signaling, and reader-action notes, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Diagnose why a storyboard peer comment fails by identifying which of the three properties (anchored, actionable, authorship-preserving) is missing.
Rewrite a praise or taste comment into a three-part review (observation, anchor, option) that cites a Mayer principle or the frame objective.
Explain why the author's documented accept-or-reject response, not the comment itself, is the design evidence, and why a principled rejection can be stronger than an acceptance.
Maintain anchored, authorship-preserving review across a power gradient, as in the senior-to-junior transfer case.
